# BrutalKit

> A lightweight, dependency-free Neo-Brutalist CSS component library with optional vanilla JavaScript interactions.

BrutalKit provides composable `bk-` CSS primitives for buttons, cards, badges, forms, alerts, layout, tabs, dialogs, accordions, and tooltips. It does not impose a framework or global reset.

## Canonical project resources

- [README](https://github.com/ravvdevv/brutal-kit/blob/main/README.md): overview, installation, component inventory, and development.
- [Full AI reference](https://github.com/ravvdevv/brutal-kit/blob/main/llms-full.txt): architecture, APIs, integration, and agent workflow.
- [Component manifest](https://github.com/ravvdevv/brutal-kit/blob/main/components.json): machine-readable classes and behavior contracts.
- [Manifest schema](https://github.com/ravvdevv/brutal-kit/blob/main/schemas/components.schema.json): JSON Schema for component metadata.
- [Architecture guide](https://github.com/ravvdevv/brutal-kit/blob/main/docs/architecture.md): runtime boundaries and performance constraints.
- [Implementation recipes](https://github.com/ravvdevv/brutal-kit/blob/main/docs/recipes.md): copyable semantic examples.
- [Documentation](https://brutal-kit.vercel.app/docs.html): rendered component reference.
- [Source CSS](https://github.com/ravvdevv/brutal-kit/blob/main/src/brutal.css): source of truth for tokens and styles.
- [Optional JavaScript](https://github.com/ravvdevv/brutal-kit/blob/main/src/brutal.js): tabs and dialog behavior.
- [Agent instructions](https://github.com/ravvdevv/brutal-kit/blob/main/AGENTS.md): repository rules for coding agents.

## Quick integration

```html
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/ravvdevv/brutal-kit@main/dist/brutal.min.css">
<button class="bk-button bk-button--primary" type="button">Continue</button>
```

Pin an immutable release tag for production when one exists. The `@main` CDN URL follows the moving default branch.

Optional interactions:

```js
import { initBrutalKit } from "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/ravvdevv/brutal-kit@main/src/brutal.js";
initBrutalKit(document.querySelector("#app"));
```

The module auto-initializes the document in a browser. Call the initializer for a separately mounted root. It currently handles tabs and native dialog triggers only.

## Project facts

- CSS-first and framework-agnostic; no runtime dependency for CSS usage.
- Uses `bk-` classes and `--bk-` CSS custom properties.
- No global reset or global element styling.
- Source styles: `src/brutal.css`; generated artifacts: `dist/`.
- Build: `bun run build`; tests: `bun run test`.
- Manifest validation: `bun run check:manifest`.
- Bundle guardrails: `bun run check:size`.
- Full local gate: `bun run check`.
- Read `AGENTS.md` before modifying the repository.
